title: Any-signal comparison blocking
purpose: Let shared embedding buckets, entity IDs, label paths, or object fields independently propose pairwise comparison candidates while deduplicating pair keys globally.
privacy_rule: Run within tenant/privacy partitions before using broad graph or embedding signals.

title: Embedding bucket blocking signal
purpose: Use deterministic embedding_bucket dimensions as a cheap pre-vector candidate generator before pgvector search or model judging.
privacy_rule: Buckets must be derived from normalized metadata, not private raw content.

title: Entity overlap comparison feature
purpose: Use shared canonical entities such as verticals, jurisdictions, workflow stages, inputs, outputs, and risk concepts as comparison features.
privacy_rule: Entity refs should use canonical IDs and reviewed aliases where possible.

title: Checkpoint dedup across block keys
purpose: Count and skip completed pair keys once even when multiple block keys propose the same pair.
privacy_rule: Checkpoint rows should store pair IDs and job metadata, not raw object bodies.
